nodes.description: Mapping of account balances; mutated by transfer, transferFrom, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount allowances, mutated by approve, increaseAllowance, decreaseAllowance, transferFrom and burnFrom.
Total token supply, decreased on every burn performed by transfer/transferFrom/_burn.
Public rounding constant (100) read by findOnePercent to compute the burn percentage.
Public uint256 declared but unused in logic; typical timestamp/start-date holder.
Public transfer that burns a percentage via findOnePercent and moves the rest to the recipient, limited to 5000 tokens per call.
Public allowance-based transfer that burns double the percentage and decrements both balance and allowance.
Public batch transfer looping over receiver/amount arrays and calling transfer.
Public approval setter writing _allowed[msg.sender][spender] without zero-address/value checks beyond spender != 0.
Public allowance increaser adding addedValue to the caller's allowance.
Public allowance decreaser subtracting subtractedValue from the caller's allowance.
Internal mint that credits balances without increasing _totalSupply tracking consistency.
Internal burn reducing _totalSupply and account balance.
External burn of the caller's own balance via _burn.
External burn of another account's balance funded by the caller's allowance.
View helper rounding value up to basePercent multiples and returning one percent of it (rounded).
Deployment constructor that mints the whole _totalSupply to msg.sender.
View returning _totalSupply.
View returning the balance of an owner from _balances.
View returning the allowance of spender for owner from _allowed.
SafeMath helper rounding a up to the nearest multiple of m.
Caller address used as the owner/spender key for balances, allowances and burns.
Block timestamp that can be assigned to the public startDate state variable.
Balance/totalSupply arithmetic in transfer: value is split with findOnePercent rounding up, so burn+transfer amounts are not exactly value.
transferFrom computes tokensToBurn = findOnePercent(value).mul(2) then value.sub(tokensToBurn); when the doubled burn exceeds value the subtraction reverts.
Unbounded loop over caller-supplied arrays in multiTransfer; gas exhaustion or reverting inner transfer can DoS the batch.
Allowance subtraction in decreaseAllowance relies on SafeMath assert; it can revert or be manipulated by approvals.
Allowance spend in burnFrom: any address with allowance can destroy another account's tokens.
Destination address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Local tokensToBurn computed by findOnePercent inside transfer.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Local tokensToBurn = findOnePercent(value).mul(2) inside transferFrom.
Receivers array parameter of multiTransfer.
Amounts array parameter of multiTransfer.
Loop counter of multiTransfer.
Amount parameter of burnFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender selects the balance debited in transfer, so the caller identity controls value flow.
msg.sender is used as the spender key when checking and decrementing _allowed in transferFrom.
burn destroys the balance of msg.sender without further authorization.
transferFrom reaches the unsafe arithmetic where tokensToBurn is doubled and subtracted from value.
transfer reaches the split arithmetic of value into burn and transfer amounts subject to rounding.
transfer calls findOnePercent to derive the burn amount.
transferFrom calls findOnePercent to derive the doubled burn amount.
multiTransfer invokes transfer once per receiver/amount pair.
multiTransfer contains the unbounded caller-controlled loop.
findOnePercent reads the basePercent rounding constant.
findOnePercent rounds up using SafeMath ceil.
transfer writes the sender and recipient entries of _balances.
transfer reduces _totalSupply by the burn amount.
transferFrom debits the from balance and credits the to balance.
transferFrom decrements the allowance of msg.sender for from.
transferFrom reduces _totalSupply by the doubled burn.
_burn decrements _totalSupply.
_burn decrements the account balance.
burn delegates to _burn with msg.sender as account.
burnFrom checks and decrements _allowed[account][msg.sender] before burning.
burnFrom reaches the allowance-spend operation that lets a spender destroy another account's tokens.
burnFrom delegates the actual destruction to _burn.
constructor mints the initial supply through _mint.
_mint credits the recipient balance in _balances.
decreaseAllowance reaches the allowance subtraction operation.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance into _allowed.
increaseAllowance writes the raised allowance into _allowed.
approve overwrites _allowed[msg.sender][spender] with value.
block.timestamp can be stored into the public startDate variable, creating a timestamp dependency.
value parameter drives the burn/transfer split in transfer.
to parameter is the credit destination in transfer.
value parameter drives the doubled burn in transferFrom.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
receivers array drives the loop length and destinations in multiTransfer.
amounts array provides the transfer values in multiTransfer.
loop index i controls iteration over the caller-supplied arrays.
amount parameter is the value checked against allowance and burned in burnFrom.
local tokensToBurn feeds the burn/split arithmetic in transfer.
local tokensToBurn of transferFrom feeds the subtraction that can underflow.

normalization_plan.reason: Destination parameter only influences the transfer function's balance write.
Amount parameter is consumed only inside transfer.
Local burn amount is the intermediate value of the unsafe arithmetic in transfer.
Amount parameter is consumed only inside transferFrom.
Source parameter is consumed only inside transferFrom.
Doubled local burn amount is the intermediate value of the unsafe subtraction in transferFrom.
Receivers array is only iterated by multiTransfer.
Amounts array is only iterated by multiTransfer.
Loop counter belongs to the unbounded loop operation.
Amount parameter is consumed only inside burnFrom.
